data.title: Rejection of household help (Ablehnung Haushaltshilfe) - Muster BKK
data.summary: Muster BKK rejected David Muster's application for household help (Haushaltshilfe) during a hospital stay, stating that no child under twelve lives in his household and the statutes don't provide broader benefits. He may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurer, Muster BKK, has turned down your request for a household helper while you're in hospital, because household help under this rule only applies if a child under 12 lives with you, or if the insurer's own rules grant more. If you disagree, you can file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing, electronically, or in person at the office, within one month of being notified of this decision. The app will show the deadline. If you miss it, the rejection becomes final, so it may help to explain in your objection why the decision is wrong or to seek advice, e.g. from a Sozialverband or lawyer.
